applications.name: Window of Opportunity - Stun
applications.description: The Defender starts the fight Stun Immune. Whenever they would be Stunned, the Attacker is instead Stunned for 4 second(s). When the Immunity returns, it Passively Purifies all Stun Debuffs on the Defender, then they are removed by the Immunity.
